title: Human Resource Administrator
description:
• Located in Barra da Tijuca - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil


• Full Time Position, Monday – Friday 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The Human Resources Administrator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support across core  Human Resources functions in Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT), applicable collective bargaining agreements, and internal company policies. This role supports employee lifecycle processes including onboarding/offboarding, employee record maintenance, benefits administration support, recruitment coordination, HR reporting, and employee inquiry response. The HR Administrator handles confidential employee information in accordance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) and maintains accurate documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.

Tasks:


• Support the end-to-end onboarding and offboarding process, including collection and validation of mandatory personal documents, coordination of pre-employment medical examinations (ASO), and preparation/maintenance of employment documentation.


• Maintain accurate physical and digital employee personnel files (contracts, amendments, acknowledgements, and supporting documentation) and ensure records are up to date.


• Coordinate HR data entry, updates, and reporting in HRIS (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow or local systems) and support required submissions and recordkeeping for Brazil (e.g., eSocial data coordination as applicable).


• Provide administrative support for benefits and statutory programs, responding to employee questions regarding benefits and leave (e.g., vacation scheduling, meal/transportation vouchers where applicable) and routing complex items to HR leadership or vendors.


• Coordinate recruitment administration, including job postings support, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and onboarding logistics.


• Support compliance activities by tracking key dates and documents (e.g., probationary period checkpoints, contract renewals for fixed-term hires, and required acknowledgements).


• Assist with internal HR communications and policy administration, including distribution of policies, collection of employee acknowledgements, and maintaining policy records.


• Partner with local stakeholders (e.g., accounting/payroll providers) to support timely processing by providing accurate employee data and documentation, while maintaining confidentiality and data privacy controls.


• Contribute to continuous improvement of HR administrative processes, templates, and checklists to increase accuracy, speed, and compliance readiness.

Compliance and Data Privacy (Brazil):


• Work is performed in alignment with CLT requirements and any applicable collective bargaining agreements, including proper documentation of the employment relationship.


• Maintain confidentiality and process personal data in accordance with LGPD principles (purpose limitation, necessity, security, and accountability).


• Support accurate recordkeeping needed for statutory obligations and inspections, escalating questions to HR leadership or legal counsel as appropriate.

Skills and Knowledge:


• Working knowledge of core HR administration practices and familiarity with Brazilian Labor concepts (CLT) and HR documentation standards.


• High attention to detail, strong organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


• Professional communication skills: English proficiency (written and verbal) required.


• Discretion and integrity when handling confidential employee information and sensitive issues.


• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort learning HRIS/payroll portals.


• Strong customer-service orientation and ability to work collaboratively with employees and cross-functional partners.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no supervisory responsibilities; however, it provides administrative support and guidance to employees on HR processes and directs questions to appropriate stakeholders when needed.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time position. As such, the Human Resource Administrator is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program offered to Katalyst employees.

Standard days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with flexibility as needed to support business requirements and local timekeeping practices.

Travel:

Occasional local travel may be required for this position. If an offsite meeting or errand is requested, eligible mileage reimbursement will follow company policy and applicable local guidance.

Required Education and Experience


• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.


• Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in HR administration, HR operations, or a similar role.


• Experience supporting onboarding documentation, personnel file maintenance, and benefits/employee inquiries.


• Experience working with HRIS platforms (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow) and coordinating HR data updates and reporting.HR certification or coursework (local or international) is a plus.

Resumes can be submitted to our Career Center by visiting our Katalyst Career Center.

title: Network Solution Architect
description:
About Us
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own  aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.
About the Team

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
About the Role

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non-functional and functional state-of-the-art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

About You

Must-haves

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud-based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big-picture goals inform technical details and vice-versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi-cultural/multi-country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Pore Pressure and Fracture Gradient
description:
Role Synopsis
The central Western Hemisphere Pore Pressure and Geomechanics team located in Houston is looking for a professional specialist to join the Western Hemisphere central PPFG/Geomechanics team in Rio de Janeiro.
The successful candidate will and support well planning and execution for in Brazil, as well as work with the broader team supporting all of the Western Hemisphere. This team supports all of the Gulf of Mexico, Trinidad, and Western Hemisphere exploration. (including Brazil and Canada) producing assets and exploration activities offshore.
In addition, the team is becoming increasingly involved in appraisal and development work for Carbon Collection Utilization and Storage (CCUS) in the US. We work closely with our subsurface and wells teams both in the Western Hemisphere as well as globally to safely and optimally deliver wells for bp.
The Senior Specialist is an integral member of the cross-disciplinary well delivery teams and provides support for well planning and execution by developing geologically sound and compliant pore and fracture pressure forecasts and wellbore stability models. Is involved in all aspects of well planning from early concept, through detailed well planning, execution and post well analysis. During implement the specialist also collaborates with the Real Time Collaboration Operations Center on pressure detection efforts and with subsurface, drilling, and completions to incorporate pore pressure and wellbore stability takeaways and understanding to safely and successfully implement the wells.
Primary Accountabilities
Pore Pressure and Fracture Pressure Forecasting:
Is encouraged to integrate multiple types of indicators and observations in a geologic context to generate a pre-drill pore pressure and fracture gradient (PPFG) forecast. This may include: pressure from seismic velocities, offset well data such as measured pressures, connection gases, log derived pressures in shale, and basin models for building the pore pressure model and log data, drilling events/data, mini-frac/leakoff test data, lost circulation events, impact of reservoir depletion and lithology variations to constrain fracture gradient and minimum stress.
Then will integrate their work with others on the multi-disciplinary well planning team to optimize the pattern on the selection of drilling fluid type/weight, casing string compose, setting depths, potential geo-hazards and mitigation techniques. They will also be able to communicate the technical work as well as the risks and mitigations to a wide range of partners, ranging from the drilling team, the Operations team supervising the well, leadership as well as co-owners and governmental regulators.
Operational Support for Pore Pressure Detection as required for sophisticated development or exploration wells in collaboration with the remote collaboration center; including real-time model calibration, kick analysis, gas and breathing analysis and losses investigations as well as interpretation of formation integrity tests. Also, will be responsible for communicating the updated PPFG model and forecast going forward to the operations team and to recommend potential changes to mudweight or drilling strategy and potential locations for pressure points.
Drillability Assessment: work closely with wells to develop wellbore strengthening model and implementation plan for drilling through depleted reservoirs.
Wellbore stability analysis: Developing wellbore stability models as the basis for providing minimum mud weight recommendations for drilling and completing wells. There will be an emphasis on analysis and integration of data from multiple sources e.g. log data, drilling data, cavings analysis, image and caliper log analysis etc.
Operational assessment: contribute to Reservoir Design and Operating Limits, broaching analyses, zonal isolation assessment, alternate well design, abandonment deviation/risk assessments. Participate in risk assessments to represent the PPFG, zonal isolation and broaching risks.
Participation in subsurface related non-productive time (NPT) analyses and investigations.
Support development and implementation of a best-in-class PPFG and Geomechanics toolkit.
Represent BP externally as required at industry meetings and JIPs etc.
Mentor for less experienced team members
Education
Engineering, Science, Geoscience, Geomechanics or Mathematics
Crucial Criteria
Seasoned and Vast experience in relevant oilfield (drilling PPFG/geomechanics) with operator or service company.
Strong communication skills with the ability to distill complicated technical work to a variety of interested parties.
Ability to work with cross-disciplinary teams and going for priorities to deliver ambitious wells.
The candidate must be familiar with PPFG, geomechanics, drilling and subsurface aspects of Well Planning and Execution.
Desirable Qualifications
Previous PPFG experience with an operator, ideally planning and performing Brazil pre-salt wells; previous geomechanics experience such as wellbore stability and formation pressure integrity tests, strong geology and geophysics background and experience with well planning.
Experience generating pre-drill PPFG forecasts for offshore wells in both development and exploration settings.
Awareness of Geology, Petrophysics, Basin Modelling, Processing Geophysics, Reservoir Geomechanics, Drilling Engineering, Rig Systems, and Well Control.
Software proficiency and coding capability (e.g., VBA, Python, Techlog and Petrel).
Why join us
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and ambitious environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to encouraging an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
There are many aspects of our employees' lives that are meaningful, so we o8er benefits ) to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

The CTO is no longer involved in day-to-day engineering

Features ship without drama or rework

Early-career engineers

title: Project Management Support
description:
Job Highlight
PT - Standar TDR Clasificado
Esta vaga tem como objetivo identificar um grupo de candidatos a Project Management Support Senior Associate para projetos existentes e futuros no Brasil.
PORTFÓLIO ATUAL: O portfólio do Brasil atualmente implementa 17 projetos – 13 projetos de infraestrutura que variam de baixa, média e alta complexidade, bem como 4 projetos que gerenciam logística para ajuda humanitária, iniciativas de desenvolvimento social e parcerias público-privadas. Os projetos existentes incluem a prestação de apoio ao Fundo Nacional de Desenvolvimento da Educação na finalização da construção de escolas para comunidades indígenas e tradicionais; a gestão da implementação da compensação por dano moral coletivo para bairros afetados por subsidência de mineração em Maceió; o apoio ao Ministério das Cidades na elaboração de 120 planos municipais de redução de risco de desastres (apenas consultoria); e a conclusão da Etapa 1 do Campus da Universidade Federal da Integração Latino-Americana (UNILA) em Foz do Iguaçu; entre outros. Esses projetos, e outros semelhantes no pipeline, são implementados em estreita colaboração com o doador e/ou beneficiários, e variam em complexidade, escopo e valor, de US$ 4 milhões a US$ 150 milhões.
PIPELINE – INSTALAÇÕES INSTITUCIONAIS: O pipeline atual inclui oportunidades para gerenciar o design e/ou a construção e supervisão de instalações institucionais — como edifícios de escritórios públicos, hospital, museu, escolas e projetos de água e saneamento — localizadas em Brasília, Foz do Iguaçu, São Paulo, Pará e outras localidades em todo o Brasil.
Apoiar o sucesso dos projetos por meio de suporte contínuo e excelência operacional.
EN - Standar TDR Clasificado
This vacancy aims to identify a pool of Project Management Support Senior Associate candidates for existing and future projects in Brazil.
CURRENT PORTFOLIO: The Brazil portfolio currently implements 17 projects - 13 infrastructure projects ranging from low, medium and high complexity, as well as 4 projects that manage logistics for humanitarian aid, social development initiatives, and private-public partnerships. Existing projects include the provision of support to the National Education Development Fund in finalizing the construction of schools for indigenous and traditional communities; Managing the implementation of collective moral damage compensation for neighborhoods affected by mining subsidence in Maceio, supporting the Ministry of Cities in preparing 120 municipal disaster risk reduction plans(advisory only); and concluding Stage 1 of the Campus of the Federal University for Latin American Integration (UNILA) in Foz do Iguaçu; among others. These Projects, and others similar in pipeline, are implemented in close collaboration with the donor and/or beneficiaries, and range in complexity, scope and price from $4 million to $150 million.
PIPELINE - INSTITUTIONAL FACILITIES: The current pipeline includes opportunities to manage the design, and/or construction and supervision of institutional facilities—such as public office buildings, hospital, museum, schools, and water and sanitation projects —located in Brasília, Foz do Iguaçu, São Paulo, Pará, and other locations across Brazil.
Supporting project success through seamless support and operational excellence.
Role Purpose
PT
O Project Management Support Senior Associate fornece apoio técnico, administrativo e logístico para garantir a entrega eficiente e eficaz das operações do projeto. O titular do cargo contribui para a coordenação e execução dos processos cotidianos de gestão de projetos, assegurando a conformidade com os padrões e procedimentos do UNOPS. A função é focada no parceiro e orientada a resultados no apoio à implementação oportuna dos projetos
EN
The Project Management Support Senior Associate provides technical, administrative and logistical support to ensure the efficient and effective delivery of project operations. The incumbent contributes to the coordination and execution of day-to-day project management processes, ensuring compliance with UNOPS standards and procedures. The role is stakeholder-focused and results-oriented in supporting timely project implementation.
Functions / Key Results Expected
PT - Standar TDR Clasificado
Monitoramento e Relatórios de Projetos
Apoiar o supervisor no monitoramento da implementação do projeto e do desempenho financeiro para garantir a conformidade com as regras, regulamentos e padrões de relatórios do UNOPS.
Preparar e manter relatórios de desembolso financeiro e atualizações de progresso em coordenação com Finanças e unidades relevantes.
Manter documentação abrangente do projeto, incluindo registros financeiros, arquivos de auditoria e lançamentos no Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) (oneUNOPS), garantindo precisão e integridade.
Acompanhar orçamentos do projeto, fluxo de caixa e despesas. Identificar variações, propor revisões orçamentárias e iniciar ações corretivas quando necessário.
Registrar dados e atualizações do projeto em logs e registros relevantes, garantindo a precisão das informações para relatórios e auditorias.
Elaborar atas de reuniões, acompanhar pontos de ação e auxiliar na compilação de relatórios periódicos de desempenho do projeto e relatórios de encerramento.
Apoio à Implementação e Entrega de Projetos
Auxiliar na execução cotidiana do projeto, garantindo a adesão às metodologias de gestão de projetos do UNOPS, às regulamentações financeiras e aos padrões de qualidade.
Apoiar a preparação, alteração e monitoramento de planos de trabalho do projeto, acordos e revisões orçamentárias.
Facilitar a comunicação entre parceiros, prestadores de serviços e equipes internas para garantir a entrega oportuna das atividades do projeto.
Acompanhar marcos do projeto, riscos e questões, mantendo registros atualizados e auxiliando no planejamento de mitigação.
Apoiar a preparação e revisão de faturas de contratados, a verificação de documentos comprobatórios e a coordenação das entregas.
Contribuir para a identificação de gargalos operacionais ou administrativos e propor soluções práticas para aumentar a eficiência do projeto.
Apoio Operacional e Administrativo
Fornecer assistência administrativa nas operações do projeto, incluindo coordenação de RH, planejamento de aquisições e arranjos logísticos.
Apoiar a preparação de Terms of Reference (ToRs), contratos e ordens de compra. Revisar a documentação de suporte antes do envio para aprovação.
Coordenar e organizar workshops, treinamentos, reuniões e missões, garantindo arranjos logísticos, financeiros e de viagem oportunos.
Articular-se com as unidades de Finanças, RH e Aquisições para processar pagamentos, monitorar compromissos e garantir a conformidade com os sistemas de controle interno.
Manter a correspondência, os registros e os sistemas de arquivamento do projeto de acordo com as políticas de gestão documental do UNOPS.
Apoiar os processos de integração, indução e gestão de contratos para o pessoal do projeto e consultores.
Gestão Financeira e de Aquisições
Auxiliar na preparação de orçamentos do projeto, previsões e relatórios de despesas, garantindo precisão e envio oportuno.
Monitorar transações financeiras, desembolsos e pagamentos a fornecedores em conformidade com as Regras e Regulamentos Financeiros do UNOPS.
Revisar e reconciliar contas do projeto, garantindo que as despesas estejam alinhadas com os orçamentos aprovados e planos de trabalho.
Coordenar processos de aquisição, incluindo a preparação de requisições, apoio à avaliação e acompanhamento de contratos e ordens de compra.
Facilitar a comunicação com fornecedores, gerenciar a documentação para atividades de aquisição e financeiras e garantir a entrega oportuna dos serviços.
Apoiar auditorias do projeto mantendo documentação financeira completa e auxiliando na implementação das recomendações de auditoria.
Construção e Compartilhamento de Conhecimento
Apoiar a organização, facilitação e realização de treinamentos e sessões de aprendizagem em gestão de projetos.
Participar de iniciativas de compartilhamento de conhecimento e Comunidades de Prática (CoPs), contribuindo com insights e lições aprendidas.
Realizar pesquisas sobre temas relacionados à gestão de projetos e contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios, resumos e notas informativas.
EN - Standar TDR Clasificado
Project Monitoring and Reporting
Support the supervisor in monitoring project implementation and financial performance to ensure compliance with UNOPS rules, regulations and reporting standards.
Prepare and maintain financial disbursement reports and progress updates in coordination with Finance and relevant units.
Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including financial records, audit files and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) entries (oneUNOPS), ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Track project budgets, cash flow and expenditures. Identify variances, propose budget revisions, and initiate corrective actions when necessary.
Record project data and updates in relevant logs and registers, ensuring information accuracy for reporting and audits.
Take minutes of meetings, track action points, and assist in compiling periodic project performance reports and completion reports
Project Implementation and Delivery Support
Assist in day-to-day project execution, ensuring adherence to UNOPS project management methodologies, financial regulations and quality standards.
Support the preparation, amendment, and monitoring of project work plans, agreements and budget revisions.
Facilitate communication between partners, service providers and internal teams to ensure the timely delivery of project activities.
Track project milestones, risks and issues, maintaining updated records and assisting with mitigation planning.
Support preparation and review of contractors' invoices, verification of supporting documents, and coordination of deliverables.
Contribute to identifying operational or administrative bottlenecks and propose practical solutions to enhance project efficiency.
Operational and Administrative Support
Provide administrative assistance in project operations, including HR coordination, procurement planning and logistical arrangements.
Support the preparation of Terms of Reference (ToRs), contracts and purchase orders. Review supporting documentation before submission for approval.
Coordinate and organize workshops, trainings, meetings and missions, ensuring timely logistical, financial and travel arrangements.
Liaise with Finance, HR and Procurement units to process payments, monitor commitments, and ensure compliance with internal control systems.
Maintain project correspondence, records and filing systems in accordance with UNOPS document management policies.
Support onboarding, induction, and contract management processes for project personnel and consultants.
Financial and Procurement Management
Assist in the preparation of project budgets, forecasts, and expenditure reports, ensuring accuracy and timely submission.
Monitor financial transactions, disbursements, and vendor payments in alignment with UNOPS Financial Rules and Regulations.
Review and reconcile project accounts, ensuring that expenditures align with approved budgets and work plans.
Coordinate procurement processes, including requisition preparation, evaluation support, and tracking of contracts and purchase orders.
Facilitate communication with vendors, manage documentation for procurement and financial activities, and ensure timely service delivery.
Support project audits by maintaining complete financial documentation and assisting in implementing audit recommendations.
Knowledge Building and Sharing
Support the organization, facilitation and delivery of training and learning sessions on project management.
Participate in knowledge-sharing initiatives and Communities of Practice (CoPs), contributing insights and lessons learned.
Conduct research on project management-related topics and contribute to the drafting of reports, summaries and briefing notes
Education Requirements
PT -
Obrigatório
Ensino médio (ou equivalente) com 7 anos de experiência relevante OU diploma de bacharelado (ou equivalente) em qualquer área, com 3 anos de experiência relevante, é obrigatório.
Desejável
Certificado profissional reconhecido globalmente ou filiação em Gestão de Projetos é desejável.
EN -
Required
Secondary school (or equivalent) with 7 years of relevant experience OR Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in any discipline with 3 years of relevant experience is required.
Desired
A globally recognized professional certificate or membership in Project Management is desired
Experience Requirements
PT
Obrigatório
Experiência relevante é trabalho em gestão de projetos ou áreas relacionadas.
Proficiência demonstrável no uso de ferramentas de colaboração e produtividade (por exemplo, MS Office, G-Suite, etc.) e sistemas de gestão baseados na web é obrigatória.
Desejável
Experiência de trabalho em ambientes multiculturais ou em organizações do sistema ONU em um país em desenvolvimento é desejável.
Experiência em contextos de desenvolvimento ou humanitários é desejável.
EN
Required
Relevant experience is work in project management or related areas.
Demonstrable proficiency in the use of collaboration and productivity tools (e.g. MS Office, G-Suite, etc) and web-based management systems are required.
Desired
Experience of working in multicultural environments or UN system organizations in a developing country is desired.
Experience in development or humanitarian contexts is desired.

Recrutamento Interno: Técnico Ambiental

Valorizamos nossos talentos e acreditamos em seu potencial

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades e atividades da vaga:

  • Realizar tarefas administrativas do setor (orçamentos, pedidos de compra, controle de notas fiscais referente a despesas com resíduos industriais) e controle de estoque da unidade.
  • Elaboração de documentos para a liberação dos resíduos (MTR – Manifesto de transporte de resíduos, Lista de verificação do veículo que efetua o transporte, Ficha / Envelope de emergência, Solicitação de nota fiscal), bem como toda a gestão operacional do tema, inspeção geral na planta industrial para atendimento das diretrizes de gerenciamento de resíduos, SGA.
  • Acompanhamento de melhorias e análise crítica do desempenha Ambiental do site
  • Elaboração e revisão de procedimentos operacionais do Sistema de Gestão Ambiental (ISO 14001)
  • Atuação nas unidades industriais do Grupo Eurofarma quanto aos temas relacionados ao Sistema de Gestão Ambiental, como requisitos legais, controle de qualificação prestadores de serviço, análise de não conformidades, avaliação ambiental de projetos, atualização de indicadores, etc.
  • Apoio em temas do SGA corporativos das unidades Brasil

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo e Curso Técnico
  • Domínio do Pacote Office
  • Conhecimentos do SAP
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão ambiental ISO 14001, gestão de resíduos, efluentes.

Informações adicionais

Confira as diretrizes quanto a elegibilidade para o processo interno:

  • São elegíveis a participar deste processo colaboradores efetivos, estagiários e aprendizes;
  • Possuir os requisitos mínimos exigidos para a posição conforme a descrição de cargos vigente;
  • O colaborador só poderá se candidatar ao recrutamento interno caso a vaga seja de um cargo de nível igual ou superior ao que ocupa atualmente;
  • Não serão consideradas candidaturas para cargos acima de dois níveis da atual posição do colaborador (exemplo: Analista JR se candidatar para Analista SR);
  • O colaborador deverá ter o salário + adicionais* igual ou menor que o salário oferecido na vaga, desde que a movimentação não interfira no equilíbrio interno do cargo na área em que ele será aprovado. Esta análise é realizada pelas áreas de R&S e Remuneração;
  • Serão considerados para ao recrutamento interno de Analistas nível JR, apenas aqueles candidatos que possuam formação ou tenham sua formação de nível superior prevista para conclusão em até um ano da movimentação;
  • O colaborador não poderá concorrer em 2 ou mais processos simultaneamente;
  • O tempo mínimo para participar de um novo processo é de 6 meses para a mesma função (exceto nos casos de aproveitamento interno).

Validação do gestor:

  • A inscrição somente será aceita na plataforma Gupy. Durante o preenchimento do cadastro, deve -se inserir o e-mail do seu gestor(a) imediato no campo "indicado por" no momento em que se aplicar a vaga, onde esse receberá um e-mail diretamente da plataforma Gupy e deverá aprovar sua participação. Em caso de férias do gestor(a) imediato, o candidato(a) deve informar o email do gestor(a) responsável acima.

Local de Trabalho:

  • Local: Rio de Janeiro – RJ
  • Horário: Adm Flex - 44h semanais

Somos uma multinacional brasileira presente em 22 países, com mais de 50 anos de história e o propósito de promover acesso à saúde para que todas as pessoas possam viver mais e melhor. É isso que move a Eurofarma todos os dias.

Com mais de 11 mil colaboradores, atuamos em todos os principais segmentos farmacêuticos e somos líderes em receituário médico no Brasil.

Sabemos do nosso importante papel de transformação na sociedade, entendendo que as pessoas são fundamentais na trajetória de crescimento, ao lado dos resultados, internacionalização, inovação e sustentabilidade, para nos tornarmos cada vez mais globais. title: Dynamics 365 CE Senior Consultant
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

The Dynamics CRM Senior Consultant is a core team member of KPMG's customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 centred solutions. The Senior Consultant will be involved in the business processes and solution design and will be hands on configuring and customising the implementation of Dynamics CRM solutions working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The position may require business travel.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • A University graduate with relevant degree within a computing or business discipline
  • Microsoft D365 CE Certifications (2016, D365) are desirable
  • Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Microsoft D365 CE covering a wide spectrum of industries and sectors
  • At least 8+ years of hands-on proven functional experience in D365 CE configuration, standard workflows, dashboards, forms & views customizations, Report development
  • Detailed knowledge and understanding of all modules within D365 CE including Sales, Marketing, Customer Service & Field Services
  • Working knowledge of the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)
  • Good understanding of Dataverse including customisations and development of Business Data Models for different solutions
  • Good understanding of Microsoft Dynamics CRM Accelerators, industry templates and add-ons
  • A proven track record of successful implementation & maintenance of a number of solutions within large client companies, preferably across a number of business verticals (Healthcare, Education, Banking, Manufacturing etc.)
  • A proven ability to develop a clear understanding of clients' needs and the ability to incorporate them into a solution
  • Experience of consultancy roles in software delivery
  • Experience in a delivery-orientated IT environment using waterfall, agile and Devops methodologies
  • Adept at Business Requirement Analysis
  • The ability to see the greater picture and suggest solutions both within and outside the current implementation
  • Experience in supporting pre-sales activities is an advantage
  • Project documentation experience especially for work packages to be implemented by offshore teams
  • Business process mapping, modelling and documentation knowledge

Responsibilities

  • The senior consultant will work as a techno-functional lead to analyse, design, develop, test, maintain and support applications developed using D365 CE by working closely with client teams and business stakeholders.
  • Contribute to activities as required including building demo and proof of concept solutions for various client presentations
  • Work on the creation of Dynamics 365 solutions and industry templates
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations of business knowledge, skills and behaviour
  • Support practice & business development activities such as Pre-Sales, Recruitment, Mentoring Juniors, Sharing knowledge, Initiatives etc.
  • Ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory trainings
  • Carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the management team
  • Represent our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team in a professional and positive manner at all times
  • The Employee is required to follow our client's Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times
  • Perform Project responsibilities as described and given below, towards Team (lead), Client (client facing) and Governance (aiding Project Managers)

Individual

  • Organise, manage and document workshops, meetings and requirements sessions with the client representatives, project stakeholders
  • Verifying customer requirements to ensure completeness and correctness by working with technical consultants/leads. Ask relevant and right questions to gather additional information to avoid confusion. Provide accurate estimations for tasks
  • Responsible involvement in low-level and high-level design; architecture/design of project; creation and elaboration of requirements/tasks to be given to technical leads/developers/team members; project documentation
  • Lay down quality guidelines (requirement traceability, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, other design standards etc.) for the project
  • Working closely with Technical Lead to setup quality gates and quality threshold parameters for project
  • Complete allocated tasks as per schedule with appropriate quality
  • Augment decision making for "inventing vs. re-using" knowledge/assets with appropriate reasoning. Get consensus from stakeholders and document decision for all project related decisions
  • Proactively raise and document concerns, risks, impediments pertaining to various aspects of project and provide support to mitigate them with appropriate RACI
  • Triage bugs, issues etc along with Technical lead during testing (System, UAT, Integration etc.)
  • Decision making with appropriate/relevant insights

Towards Team

  • Provide a clear definition for "Done"
  • Allocate work items/tasks to team members
  • Perform review of work done and provide necessary review comments to enforce quality
  • Provide required guidance and support to team members when stuck
  • Provide details to team on quality standards to be adhered
  • Setup and conduct daily stand-up meeting with team
  • Conduct monthly technical retrospective meetings with actionable outcomes.
  • Keep a check on everyone's understanding of end-goal
  • Involve appropriate team members for necessary decisions and take accountability of decisions
  • Advocate for feature reusability and efficiency gain

Towards Client

  • Participate in customer workshops as necessary
  • Provide guidance to customer and their IT/Business Analysts team
  • Provide sufficient reasoning for features that look "out of league"; Challenge the client on such requirements and suggest trade-offs as necessary
  • Provide clear weekly progress/status report for self and team
  • Highlight risks or impediments in appropriate forums

Towards Governance

  • Provide guidance and support in setup of Dev Management processes
  • Guidance in setting up right DevOps system & tools; Setup CI/CD pipeline with appropriate templates
  • Verification of Automate Build and release management (including Roll-back plans)
  • Setup and verification of right branching and merging strategy
  • Represent & provide opinions in management reviews or steering committee reviews
  • Ensure team calendar is up to date; Ensure appropriate work distribution, backup/backfill planning
  • Document Lessons Learnt and share it in broader forums
  • Provide immediate and appropriate feedback to team members

Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

At our client, your long-term future is every bit as important to them as it is to you. That's why our clients aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. Our client is a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, our clients, and our communities.

This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded at our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

For this exciting opportunity they have put together a great package that combines a competitive salary with a bundle of extras including allowances, business travel allowances, certifications to support you in your career growth, private insurance, and medical insurance for you and your family.

Don't worry, our client knows that relocation can be a challenge, which is why they have an extremely supportive onboarding team to help you throughout this process - They provide relocation support for you and your family. Our client is looking forward to meeting you and seeing you grow.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Grants E Parcerias
description:
A Share People Hub, em parceria com uma organização filantrópica dedicada ao enfrentamento das mudanças climáticas no Brasil, está buscando Pessoa Coordenadora de Grants e Parcerias. Atuação híbrida no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou Brasília.


Desafios da Posição:

Responsável por apoiar a estratégia de captação institucional por meio da gestão qualificada de propostas, relacionamento com financiadores e coordenação dos processos técnicos e operacionais que sustentam o ciclo de captação.Esta posição atua em parceria direta com o Gerente de Parcerias, sendo o ponto de conexão entre financiadores, equipe técnica, consultores e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, consistência e previsibilidade em todas as etapas do ciclo de captação e relacionamento com doadores.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a execução da estratégia de captação institucional, em articulação com a Diretoria Executiva e áreas programáticas.
  • Gerir o pipeline de captação, acompanhando todas as etapas: prospecção, qualificação, reuniões, propostas, negociação e fechamento.
  • Prospectar e mapear novas oportunidades junto a fundações, doadores institucionais, cooperação bilateral e multilateral, no Brasil e no exterior.
  • Analisar estrategicamente potenciais financiadores, avaliando alinhamento com a agenda climática e prioridades institucionais.
  • Coordenar a elaboração e revisão de propostas narrativas e conceituais, assegurando qualidade técnica, clareza e aderência aos requisitos dos financiadores.
  • Organizar e validar documentos institucionais necessários para submissões, contratos, liberações de recursos e aditivos.
  • Apoiar a gestão do relacionamento com financiadores, participando de reuniões, acompanhando demandas e garantindo a qualidade da comunicação institucional.
  • Coordenar a preparação e revisão de relatórios narrativos, assegurando consistência, cumprimento contratual e alinhamento com os dados financeiros.
  • Monitorar prazos, entregas e compromissos acordados com financiadores, em articulação com as áreas técnicas, administrativas e financeiras.
  • Garantir a atualização e a confiabilidade dos dados no sistema de gestão de doadores (pipeline, valores, status, histórico e interações).
  • Produzir análises de desempenho da captação, apoiando a previsibilidade de receitas e a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apoiar a preparação de apresentações institucionais, visitas e agendas de financiadores.

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Relações Internacionais, Gestão Pública, Políticas Públicas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em captação institucional, grants, elaboração de propostas ou gestão de parcerias com financiadores.
  • Vivência com fundações, organismos multilaterais, cooperação internacional ou financiadores institucionais.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita em português e inglês.
  • Capacidade de traduzir conteúdos técnicos em propostas claras e estratégicas.
  • Organização, planejamento e atenção a prazos e detalhes.
  • Capacidade analítica para leitura de editais, contratos e oportunidades.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de organização, acompanhamento de pipeline e produção de relatórios.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Desejável experiência com a agenda de mudança do clima, transição energética, transportes ou políticas públicas ambientais.
  • Desejável conhecimento ou familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de projetos, como FLUXX e Sales Force.
  • Vivência com projetos financiados por iniciativas bilaterais e/ou multilaterais será considerada um diferencial.

Responsividade, proatividade, senso de dono, organização, habilidade de articulação entre áreas, atenção à qualidade, pensamento crítico e capacidade de atuar em ambientes colaborativos e de alta exigência.

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.
Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Piloto de ROV para atuar em operações submarinas, assegurando a execução com segurança das manutenções dos equipamentos de ROV, além de realizar pilotagem e suporte técnico às operações offshore. Essa posição é estratégica para garantir a eficiência operacional, a segurança dos envolvidos e a excelência em entregas subsea.

Preencher o dive log e registrar manutenções realizadas.
Gravar e editar imagens/áudios conforme necessidade dos projetos.
Distribuir tarefas e orientar trainees de ROV, garantindo execução segura e eficaz.
Participar ativamente de todas as atividades relacionadas à segurança e SMS.

Ensino médio concluído e formação técnica em eletrônica, mecânica, eletrotécnica ou mecatrônica (CFT ativo);
Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência comprovada em operações submarinas como piloto de ROV (RSV, AHTS, DSV ou PLSV);
Conhecimento em hidráulica ou elétrica;
Pacote Microsoft Office;
Conhecimento em sistemas de ROV Triton XLX, XLX EVO ou XLX-C;
Conhecimento em fibra óptica;
Conhecimento em LARS ODIM ou Dynacom;
Certificações atualizadas: CBSP, NR-10 e NR-35;
Local de trabalho
Modalidade: Embarcado – Bases offshore
Disponibilidade para embarques e regime offshore
O que buscamos
Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:
Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência
Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento

title: Senior Accountant
description:

This role provides exposure to a wide range of accounting, tax, and operational processes within the energy trading business, as well as opportunities to collaborate with other business units at an international level. The position requires strong technical expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to operate in a dynamic and multicultural environment.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related fields; certified accountant is preferred.

  • Strong academic and technical background.

title: Engenheiro de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
REQUISITOS MANDATÓRIOS

ATRIBUIÇÕES

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a  Retention Marketing Specialist  within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits

This is a contract position
Up to 40 hours weekly
Remote
Selection Process

The selection process includes a video interview screening, followed by role-specific discussions (possible assessment) and a final leadership conversation.

Commitment to Inclusion

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy

Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

The Finance Analyst will play a key role in supporting the analysis and structuring of financing transactions, assessing market rates, debt and equity alternatives, and applying advanced financial models. The position is expected to contribute to the design of financial strategies aligned with corporate goals, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high-quality decision-making.

  • Proactive, versatile, and curious profile with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.

• Desenvolver parcerias sólidas com os clientes cultivando um relacionamento de confiança com foco na construção de uma percepção de valor positiva por parte do cliente;


• Envolver-se com os clientes traduzindo suas necessidades de negócios em soluções apropriadas;


• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os clientes para identificar soluções que enderecem desafios de negócios;


• A pessoa trabalhará com tecnologias em rápida evolução, componentes no local/nuvem para definir soluções exclusivas.

HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS

  • Experiência como pré-vendas e/ou arquiteto de soluções;
  • Sólido conhecimento em licitações RFPs/RFIs, preferencialmente com alguma experiência atendendo a grandes contas.

  • Conhecimentos em tecnologias de infraestrutura como banco de dados, middleware, aplicativos e hardware;

  • Experiência com relacionamento com o cliente;
  • Experiência em Multi-Cloud e Infraestrutura de TI tradicional;

HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS

  • Formação superior na área de tecnologia ou cursos relacionados;

title: Bio Ritmo
description:
Endereço
Avenida Pepe, 1360, Barra da Tijuca - Rio de Janeiro, RJ

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?
Nos esforçamos para manter um ambiente descontraído, onde a opinião de todos reflete nas decisões da equipe. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa e criativa. Estamos em constante evolução e sempre abertos a novas tendências.

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

O Grupo Smart Fit é um dos maiores ecossistemas de fitness e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Empresa brasileira, fundada por Edgard Corona, iniciou sua história em 1996 com a Bio Ritmo, levando saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida por meio de uma experiência diferenciada de atividade física.

Essa trajetória ganhou escala com a criação da Smart Fit, marca que transformou o mercado ao democratizar o acesso ao fitness de alto padrão, tornando a prática de atividade física mais acessível e presente na vida de milhões de pessoas. A partir daí, o Grupo manteve um crescimento consistente, expandindo sua atuação e diversificando seu portfólio para atender diferentes perfis, objetivos e momentos da jornada das pessoas.

Hoje, o Grupo Smart Fit está presente em mais de 16 países, conta com mais de 2.000 unidades e opera um ecossistema completo de marcas que inclui academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; a BEON Studios, que conecta estúdios especializados em uma rede única: Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore, além dos produtos digitais TotalPass e Queima Diária. Juntas, essas marcas criam experiências físicas e digitais que ampliam o acesso ao bem-estar, com praticidade, inovação e parcerias estratégicas.

Marcas do Grupo Smart Fit:

Smart Fit: A 3 maior rede de academias próprias do mundo, com acesso democrático, tecnologia e estrutura completa.

Bio Ritmo: Academia premium com treinos personalizados, equipamentos de ponta e experiência de alto padrão.

Nation CT: Mais que um centro de alta performance, uma experiência única dentro de uma infraestrutura completa e moderna. Foco em performance e comunidade.

A BEON Studios um ecossistema highend de studios que reúne múltiplas experiências de bem-estar e treinos coletivos, com inovação e excelência para nossos alunos e franqueados

Quais são os nossos estúdios?

Race Bootcamp: Treinos intervalados em esteira e musculação, com alta intensidade e experiência imersiva.

Vidya Studio: Estúdio de yoga contemporâneo, com práticas que combinam bem-estar, equilíbrio e conexão mente-corpo.

Jab House: Aulas de boxe fitness com música, luzes e dinâmica de alto gasto calórico.

Tonus Gym: Treinos focados em resistência e fortalecimento muscular com ênfase em resultados rápidos e medidos.

Kore: Studio de core training com treinos focados em estabilidade, força central e corpo inteiro.

Velocity: Aulas de bike indoor no formato boutique, com experiência sensorial e estímulo total.

Aera Pilates: Pilates contemporâneo com equipamentos modernos e treinos que unem força, consciência corporal e mobilidade.

Produtos Digitais

Queima Diária: Plataforma de treinos online com programas variados para todos os níveis e objetivos.

TotalPass: Benefício corporativo de bem-estar que dá acesso a milhares de academias, estúdios e serviços de saúde.

Você fará parte do Grupo Smart Fit, a 3 maior rede de academias próprias do mundo.Esta vaga é para atuar na Bio Ritmo, marca premium do grupo, que oferece uma experiência de treino completa, com ambientes sofisticados, serviços exclusivos e foco em performance, bem-estar e resultados

Como Estagiário(a) de Musculação da Bio Ritmo você irá:

  • Apoiar os(as) professores(as) na preparação e condução de aulas, treinamentos e atividades físicas;
  • Auxiliar os(as) alunos(as) com orientações sobre exercícios, uso adequado de equipamentos e práticas seguras;
  • Organizar e preparar os espaços para a realização de aulas e atividades, garantir a segurança e a funcionalidade dos ambientes;
  • Promover hábitos saudáveis e bem-estar, incentivar a prática regular de atividades físicas e a adoção de um estilo de vida saudável;
  • Realizar as formações dos programas de musculação;
  • Participar de encontros técnicos, reuniões da unidade e treinamentos.

Requisitos
O que esperamos de você:

  • Estar cursando a partir do 5 semestre - Bacharel em Educação Física
  • Proativo;
  • Comprometido;
  • Boa comunicação.

Benefícios

  • Academia / Práticas Esportivas
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Universidade Corporativa
  • Vale-Transporte

Sobre a Organização
O Grupo Smart Fit detém as marcas de academia full service Smart Fit & Bio Ritmo, as marcas de academias estúdio Race Bootcamp, Vidya Body & Mind, Tonus Muscle Lab, Jab House e Nós, além dos produtos digitais Total Pass e Queima Diária.

Juntas, nossas marcas possuem mais de 800 unidades e mais de 2,5 milhões de clientes ativos. Estamos presente no Brasil, México, Chile, Peru, Colômbia, República Dominicana, Equador, Argentina, Panamá, Guatemala, Paraguai, El Salvador e Honduras.

Somos a maior empresa no segmento de fitness da América Latina e a terceira maior do mundo.

title: Scrum Master
description:

Sua missão será atuar como facilitador da cultura ágil, promovendo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de projetos e uso adequado de ferramentas utilizadas.   • Atuar de forma consultiva e proativa junto aos Product Owners e líderes de tecnologia.
  • Promover iniciativas de inovação e transformação digital.
  • Buscar tendências, ferramentas e boas práticas de mercado aplicáveis à realidade da empresa.
  • Avaliar oportunidades de automação, inteligência de dados e eficiência operacional.
  • Estimular cultura de colaboração, autonomia, melhoria contínua e aprendizado.

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos ágeis, preferencialmente Azure DevOps.
  • Conhecimento prático dos frameworks Scrum.
  • Vivência em Gestão de Projetos tradicional.
  • Capacidade de criar e interpretar métricas de desempenho ágil (burnup, burndown, velocity).

Você se destaca se tiver:

SOBRE NÓS
Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.
E não para por aí
A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.
Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.
O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara
A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas".
E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

description:

Na GSK, somos movidos por ambições audaciosas para transformar vidas e gerar um impacto positivo na saúde de bilhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Nossas Global Functions estão no centro dessa missão, atuando como pilares estratégicos que conectam todas as áreas da empresa e garantem que nossas operações sejam conduzidas com excelência, eficiência e responsabilidade.

Ao unir inovação, colaboração e uma visão global, nossas funções globais tornam possível o desenvolvimento de nossas vacinas, medicamentos e inovações científicas, apoiando cada etapa do processo até que as soluções cheguem aos pacientes. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir diretamente para um futuro mais saudável e sustentável, trabalhando em um ambiente onde propósito e impacto caminham juntos.


Como Especialista de Produtividade de Vendas na GSK, você será o ponto focal da Unidade de Negócio para assuntos relacionados à Produtividade de Vendas. Irá interagir diretamente  com as áreas comerciais e de suporte, garantindo que a execução em esteja alinhada à estratégia comercial. Responsável por acompanhar a performance por meio de KPIs de execução, correlacionar dados da força de vendas com informações de mercado e gerar insights acionáveis em busca de otimizações. Ainda, irá liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, apoia decisões táticas e estratégicas e assegura governança, qualidade de dados e aderência a auditorias internas e externas.

Essa posição poderá ficar baseada no Rio de Janeiro/RJ ou São Paulo/SP.

Suas Responsabilidades:

Esse cargo dá a VOCÊ a oportunidade de liderar atividades chaves para progredir na SUA carreira, algumas delas são:

  • Ser o ponto focal dos times internos e da força de vendas para assuntos relacionados à Produtividade de Vendas, garantindo comunicação clara e priorização de iniciativas.
  • Definir, monitorar e reportar KPIs de produtividade, transformando indicadores em planos de ação.
  • Mapear riscos e oportunidades na execução dos consultores; propor intervenções corretivas e preventivas e escalar riscos operacionais com planos de mitigação.
  • Criar, atualizar e disseminar estudos de targeting e segmentação de HCPs, incluindo otimização de territórios.
  • Trabalhar em interface com o time de Remuneração Variável para garantir que modelos de incentivo estejam alinhados à estratégia corporativa e impulsionem comportamentos desejados.
  • Preparar e conduzir apresentações de performance da força de vendas para liderança e dar suporte a auditorias internas/externas, preparando evidências e implementando ações decorrentes.

Por que VOCÊ?

Suas qualificações:

Estamos a procura de pessoas/profissionais com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência profissional prévia comprovada em Produtividade de Vendas ou áreas analíticas correlatas (reporting/BI/performance de campo).
  • Experiência na indústria farmacêutica; conhecimento em Hematologia e Oncologia será diferencial.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para transformar informações em insights acionáveis.
  • Clareza para diagnosticar causa‑raiz de problemas complexos e capacidade de definir soluções e planos de ação.
  • Elevado senso de governança para processos críticos, qualidade de dados e conformidade; inglês avançado.

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Talent Matching Specialist
description:
About Virtual Internships
 


We're on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions. 
 

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to "Escape To in 2023"Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies 

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to "try before you apply" by visiting our VI-P Guide, which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are
 

Your Role


Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we're guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive. 

Whether you're already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role, with potential to become permanent dependent on performance. 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is "moo"—you'll need it later)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You'll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that's scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For


Your Attributes


We're looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter, The Persuader, and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here's how you'll know you're the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don't wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You're outcome-obsessed and don't shift blame.
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don't need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you're sharper by Day 10.
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don't just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact.
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don't rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You're comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience


We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don't need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
